errors.evidence: The tick intervals on the x-axis are not uniform. They are 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, etc. An interval of 1e8 only applies to the latter part of the axis, from 1e8 to 9e8.
The description fails to mention the marker shapes for any of the five lines (triangle, plus, x, diamond, circle), which was an explicit requirement of the generation prompt.
